purpose: Structural source baseline for V1 identity/body + V2 facial system/jump

status.originalAppearanceAndMotionPreservation: required, not yet demonstrated for a hybrid
status.facialTopologySuitability: requires visual and authoring review; counts do not establish suitability

v2Jump.implementation: MotionDirector.update: idle/gait base blend, airBlend/tuck and landing compression; host owns root flight
v2Jump.transferAcceptance: compare donor and hybrid at the same jump timeline; copying overlay constants alone is insufficient

face.transferConstraint: morph displacement arrays require correspondence to the target mesh; same channel names do not supply deformation
face.futureCompositionConstraint: FaceRig.apply writes every morph; combine future speech with emotion/blink/gaze before a single apply

limits: No mesh, skeleton, texture or animation was edited.
This structural audit is not a rendered facial-quality test, web runtime test, or Quest test.
Source fingerprints are references, not proof that a future derivative preserves appearance or deformation.
